Concept Site Plan · Rev E

Burke Energy Campus —
Full-Peninsula 2 GW Layout

The energy campus now spans the entire Burke dredge-disposal peninsula — not just the NE corner — from the west fill cell to the eastern point, with the existing pond / wetland cell preserved as a no-build buffer. Power shifts to a 5–7 unit GE Vernova 7HA.03 combined-cycle fleet with full HRSG heat recovery, lifting campus firm capacity to approximately 2 GW.
